about: Variant C of the languages design (vision/ADDENDUM_languages_2026-10-25.md; format in training/worlds/DICTIONARIES.md): a GIVEN Romanian-to-English dictionary applied word by word (longest key first) before the English diagram reader, no training. Built by training/worlds/diagram_ro/generate.py from lexicon_ro.py, the lexicon of the trained Romanian world, so the two never drift apart. Keys: folded (lower case, no diacritics), words separated by spaces; values: token sequences of the English world, before its normalizer (top_left, left_of are its canonical tokens); several values = alternatives the reader decides; an empty value drops the word. Every value token has a kind in the English world's kinds.tsv (checked when written).
